# Routing recommendation (generated by bench/routing_evidence.py)

Evidence base: 45 task samples (10 Haiku). **Haiku evidence is one task**: combo T8 `refs` (80 LOC, 1 component, fast tests, no hard Review Focus) = x1 (killed, unfinished) + 6 A/B replays + 3 mini-prime replays. Everything else about Haiku is untested.

## Recommended rules table

| Condition | Tier |
|---|---|
| `Kind: mechanical` AND LOC <= 100 AND components <= 2 AND tests fast AND no deep/numeric/state/protocol Review Focus | **haiku** |
| mechanical, LOC 101-150 | sonnet until Haiku data there clears its min first-time pass (about 10+ passes) |
| anything else (design, slow tests, hard Review Focus, > 2 components, > 150 LOC) | **sonnet** |

Critical path: **never Haiku on the critical path**, and only with `min_slack_s` = **120 s** of slack (absorbs a median miss; 15 s would absorb only the pass case). Ties and unknown slack count as on-path.

Reuse limits (policy, unmeasured): Haiku 3 tasks / 40k context per agent; Sonnet 4 tasks / 80k. Retire an agent past either limit.

## How often mechanical work is off the critical path

Strict set (Kind mechanical or lint-eligible): n=3, all from run(s) combo-superlite-x1, which was killed, so its slack says nothing. Proxies below use every task of the finished combo runs (`slack>X` = share of tasks off the critical path with more than X s of slack).

| set | run | n | slack>0 | slack>60 s | slack>120 s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all tasks | combo-superlite-v2 | 11 | 0.455 | 0.182 | 0.182 |
| all tasks | combo-superlite-v3 | 8 | 0.75 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| all tasks | combo-superlite-w3 | 6 | 0.833 | 0.833 | 0.833 |
| all tasks | **pooled** | 25 | 0.64 | 0.44 | 0.44 |
| only-LOC-over-limit | combo-superlite-v2 | 6 | 0.667 | 0.167 | 0.167 |
| only-LOC-over-limit | combo-superlite-v3 | 4 | 1.0 | 0.75 | 0.75 |
| only-LOC-over-limit | combo-superlite-w3 | 4 | 0.75 | 0.75 | 0.75 |
| only-LOC-over-limit | **pooled** | 14 | 0.786 | 0.5 | 0.5 |

Slack vs Haiku time: Haiku's extra time is +6.7 s when it passes (full prime) and a miss adds about 100.7 s (fixer-sonnet median), so a miss needs about 107 s of slack to stay invisible in run time. Median slack of off-path tasks: 270.7 s. **Recommended `min_slack_s` = 120** (pass-only alternative 15).

## Economics (off the critical path: gate = first-time pass; time budgets are secondary)

A miss costs one extra fixer-sonnet assignment: median 100.65s and $0.095 (n=16 transcripts). No Haiku miss has happened yet, so this is the price of a miss, not an observed one. Gate: p x saved >= (1-p) x miss cost (cost break-even), and a miss that overflows the typical slack must not add more than 15 s of expected run time. The +15/+30/+60 s columns are the old time-budget view.

| band | haiku n | 1st-pass (obs) | Wilson low | prime | cost saved/task | extra s vs Sonnet (base) | $ per extra s | break-even +15s | +30s | +60s | **min 1st-pass** | decidable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <=100 | 10 | 9/9 | 0.701 | full | $0.104 | +6.7 | 0.01552 | 0.918 | 0.769 | 0.47 | 0.5 | yes |
| <=100 | 10 | 9/9 | 0.701 | mini | $0.107 | -9.3 | not slower than Sonnet: saves cost and time | 0.759 | 0.61 | 0.311 | 0.5 | yes |
| 101-150 | 0 | - | - | - | NO DATA | - | - | - | - | - | - | no |

Dollars saved per extra second if the full budget were used (full prime): +15s -> $0.00693/s; +30s -> $0.00347/s; +60s -> $0.00173/s.
A base penalty <= 0 (mini prime) means Haiku is not slower on this task, so no time is bought. `min first-pass` = max(cost break-even, run-time overflow cap) rounded up to 0.05, never below 0.5. Cost break-even is about 0.48 (a miss costs about as much as one Haiku saving), and the `min_slack_s` gate already absorbs a median miss, so the floor is cost-driven. At a 0.8 pass rate the expected net saving is $0.064 per task. The 101-150 band has no Haiku data.

## Misses (Haiku tasks that did not pass first time)

Haiku tasks measured: 10; failed first time: **0**; unobserved (killed before reporting): combo-superlite-x1.mechanical T8. Rework so far: 0s, $0.

No Haiku miss has been observed, so there is no measured reason or rework cost yet (reasons tracked: NEEDS_CONTEXT, BLOCKED, red tests, wrong output).

Haiku rows other than `loc <= 100`, `components 1`, `tests fast`, `hard_review_focus none` are NO DATA. Sonnet has no sample at <= 100 LOC except x1's unfinished tasks, so cross-model comparison inside a band exists only through the A/B replay.

## Caveats

- The x1 prime is ~4.6k tokens (18.7 KB), not 15k; the mini prime is ~1.0k, below the 3-5k target, because T8's block is tiny.
- One task, one project (Python, combo/minisheet). Nothing here is language-specific, but nothing is measured for other languages: the ts-wordstat/ts-textkit/ts-logflow runs used Sonnet batch dispatches and have no per-task plan records, so they add no band data.
- First-time pass for Sonnet tasks comes from handback status and rework markers; DONE_WITH_CONCERNS counts as a pass unless rework followed.
- Critical-path and slack come from the actual times of runs whose last wave was killed or clustered; treat slack > 300 s as 'off path'.
- A/B timings include model latency noise of a few seconds; with n=3 a 10 s difference is suggestive, not significant.
- Reuse limits are policy defaults, not measured. The miss price is the measured fixer-sonnet median, not an observed Haiku miss.
